XMLDB.COMMENT: MCP web service plugin database schema.

TABLE.NAME: webservice_elediamcp_token
TABLE.COMMENT: Lifecycle and audit metadata for MCP web service tokens. Authentication is delegated to the core external_tokens row referenced by externaltokenid; this table tracks the MCP-specific scope, label, expiry and revocation state, and survives deletion of the core token so a revoked token stays auditable.

FIELD.NAME: externaltokenid
FIELD.COMMENT: Reference to the backing external_tokens.id while the token is live; nulled when the core token is deleted on revocation.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hex digest of the token value, used to correlate without persisting the secret.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the token (the Moodle user the token authenticates as).

FIELD.NAME: externalserviceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The MCP external service the token is scoped to.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable token label.

FIELD.NAME: creatorid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the token (the authenticated user for UI-created tokens, or the user on whose behalf a first-party plugin acted).

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle component of the first-party plugin that provisioned the token via the internal API, or null for self-service tokens.

FIELD.NAME: validuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Expiry timestamp mirrored from the core token, retained for display after revocation. 0 or null means no expiry.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Creation timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: lastaccess
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the last-used timestamp, taken at revocation so it survives deletion of the core token.

FIELD.NAME: revoked
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the token has been revoked, 0 otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: timerevoked
FIELD.COMMENT: Revocation timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: revokedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who revoked the token, or null when revoked programmatically.

INDEX.NAME: tokenhash
INDEX.COMMENT: Used to correlate a presented token value with its metadata row.

INDEX.NAME: userid-revoked
INDEX.COMMENT: Used to list a user's active or revoked tokens.

TABLE.NAME: webservice_elediamcp_oauth_client
TABLE.COMMENT: OAuth 2.1 client registrations for the MCP authorization server. A client is a public (PKCE-only) MCP client, either dynamically registered (RFC 7591) or provisioned by an administrator. No client secret is stored: every client authenticates with PKCE.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: Public, opaque OAuth client identifier issued to the client.

FIELD.NAME: clientname
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable client name shown on the consent screen.

FIELD.NAME: redirecturis
FIELD.COMMENT: Newline-separated list of exact, pre-registered redirect URIs the client may use.

FIELD.NAME: granttypes
FIELD.COMMENT: Space-separated OAuth grant types the client is allowed to use.

FIELD.NAME: responsetypes
FIELD.COMMENT: Space-separated OAuth response types the client is allowed to request.

FIELD.NAME: tokenendpointauthmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Token endpoint authentication method; always 'none' (public PKCE client).

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Space-separated scopes the client requested at registration, advisory only.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Registration timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last modification timestamp.

INDEX.NAME: clientid
INDEX.COMMENT: Unique lookup of a client by its issued identifier.

TABLE.NAME: webservice_elediamcp_oauth_code
TABLE.COMMENT: Short-lived, single-use OAuth 2.1 authorization codes bound to a user, client, redirect URI and PKCE challenge. Only the SHA-256 hash of the code value is stored; the plaintext code exists only in the redirect to the client. Rows are deleted on successful exchange and pruned once expired.

FIELD.NAME: codehash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hex digest of the authorization code value; the plaintext is never stored.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: OAuth client the code was issued to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user who authorised the request; the token minted from this code authenticates as this user.

FIELD.NAME: redirecturi
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact redirect URI presented in the authorization request; must be replayed identically at the token endpoint.

FIELD.NAME: codechallenge
FIELD.COMMENT: PKCE code challenge (base64url of SHA-256 of the verifier).

FIELD.NAME: codechallengemethod
FIELD.COMMENT: PKCE challenge method; only S256 is accepted.

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Scopes approved for this code, advisory only.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Expiry timestamp; the code is invalid at or after this time.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Issuance timestamp.

INDEX.NAME: codehash
INDEX.COMMENT: Unique lookup of an authorization code by hash.
